purpose: Evaluate public indexes as a legitimate fallback when official search endpoints are challenge-gated.

limitations: coverage and freshness are not authoritative

official_constraint: TJAP's official rules recognize external jurisprudence repositories only when authorized by the court; a public index alone does not establish that authorization.
decision: Do not use third-party indexes to bypass TJAP/TJMA access controls or promote national coverage. They may be used manually as leads for locating official document identifiers, followed by direct official-source validation.
